answer: Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the inlet checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. The yarrow graph is rebuilt each epoch, so that the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the tide audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 2 times its size, so a group of 53 keys loses far more than 53 single identities would. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
